verdict.rationale: Figma documents a public REST API for reading files, objects, layers and properties, plus usage data and webhooks. It publishes an OpenAPI spec and TypeScript types, offers a Variables API with full create/update/delete, and supports plan-scoped tokens for CI/CD-style automation; the Plugin API adds read/write access to editor content. The OpenAPI probe 404s only reflect the spec living in a GitHub repo, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: documented REST write access to general canvas content (write is limited to variables, with canvas writes going through plugins or MCP), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents driving the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Leverage the power of our REST API to bring Figma into your external tools and products.
view and extract any objects or layers, and their properties from files, get usage data, or listen for events with webhooks
This repository contains the OpenAPI specification and Typescript types for the Figma REST API
The Variables REST API includes endpoints for querying, creating, updating, and deleting variables.
useful for needs like CI/CD implementations, logging, creating user-agnostic webhooks, and other tasks that you normally wouldn't want gated by a single individual
The Plugin API supports both read and write access to Figma's editors, allowing developers to view, create, and modify the contents of files.
